number.pick: What number do you call in an emergency in {label}?

rows.label: United States
rows.description: country located primarily in North America
rows.hook: is home to the Statue of Liberty, Hollywood, and the Grand Canyon

rows.label: Canada
rows.hook: is known for maple syrup, ice hockey, and vast snowy wilderness

rows.label: United Kingdom
rows.hook: is home to Big Ben, the Royal Family, and the birthplace of Shakespeare

rows.label: Australia
rows.hook: is home to kangaroos, the Sydney Opera House, and vast outback deserts

rows.label: New Zealand
rows.description: island country in the southwest Pacific Ocean
rows.hook: is known for dramatic fjords, sheep farming, and lush green landscapes

rows.label: European Union (EU-wide)
rows.description: political and economic union of 27 European states
rows.hook: issues a shared currency called the euro and allows passport-free travel between many member countries
